name: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006

sections.title: Delayed payment to micro and small enterprises
sections.text_summary: Establishes a buyer's liability to pay compound interest, at three times the RBI-notified bank rate with monthly rests, on amounts not paid to a supplier within 45 days of acceptance of goods/services -- see [[MSME_SAMADHAAN-DELAYED-PAYMENT-INTEREST]] for the exact wording, as confirmed via the MSME Samadhaan portal's description of this provision.

source.page_or_section_ref: MSME Samadhaan homepage (describing this Act's provision)

_body:
## Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006

**Honest limitation, recorded deliberately rather than papered over.** The
Act's own PDF (linked from https://dcmsme.gov.in/publications/msmed_actx.html,
at http://www.dcmsme.gov.in/MSMED2006.pdf) is a **scanned image with no
text layer** — it could not be read or quoted directly by this fetch. The
delayed-payment provision recorded here is transcribed from the MSME
Samadhaan portal's own description of the Act's rule, not from reading the
Act's primary text, and `section_no` is deliberately left `"unconfirmed"`
rather than guessed. Getting a real digitised copy of this Act (e.g. via
India Code, which returned HTTP 403 on the URL attempted here, or OCR of
the scanned PDF) is real follow-up work, not done in this pass.
